'''Sealord''' is a [[Water]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Seaswirl]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Every attack is a performance. Sealord doesn't care about winning, as long as there's flowers from fans afterward. And of course, this superstar doesn't need to worry about that hairline anymore."

Sealord is a rainbow rarity Tatari. Like all Tier 4 evolutions, it requires B Rating to acquire, therefore its feeding level cannot be below B rating for each stat.

==Appearance==
Sealord sits in an orange pool float and holds a starfish with one flipper. It is also surrounded by a mass of water and three beach balls.

Sealing's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces blue with purple, and its beach balls and pool float become red-orange and aquamarine.

== Trivia ==
* Sealord was added to the game on 5/12/2026 alongside [[Pandagrand]] and [[Hootlet]].
